candidates.name: structured_input_cache
candidates.hypothesis: Extracting explicit context and problem fields for an exact fingerprint will reuse verified answers across wrapper variations and exceed the exact-input cache's 50.0% aggregate accuracy without adding prompt context; a lower aggregate score falsifies the claim.

candidates.name: rare_feature_retrieval
candidates.hypothesis: Downweighting features repeated across stored cases and retrieving by rare-feature coverage will exceed sparse retrieval's 43.3% aggregate accuracy while keeping injected context compact; failure to improve aggregate accuracy falsifies the claim.

candidates.name: independent_draft_adjudicator
candidates.hypothesis: Two independently generated answers followed by input-grounded adjudication will exceed the draft-audit system's 53.3% aggregate accuracy by reducing anchoring on the first draft; failure to improve aggregate accuracy falsifies the claim.
